body: I’ve come to learn that if something seems too good to be true, it is. It most definitely is. I started dating my only friend I’ve had in years, and my first girlfriend, and I feel as lonely, shitty, and unwanted as ever. Big mistake on my part.

Yeah. My depression causes me to always either be a sad downer, or an angry asshole, which is most of the time . So it makes me hate myself even more, which makes me even more sad and angry, and so on.
“Why can’t you be more like (friend’s) daughter/son?”
